item.title: Woo Won-shik Declares He Will Not Run for Party Leader: “Tired of Seeing Division and Conflict in the Ruling Party” (당 대표 불출마 선언한 우원식 “與 분열·반목 보기 힘들어”)
item.description:
Woo Won-shik Declares He Will Not Run for Party Leader: “Tired of Seeing Division and Conflict in the Ruling Party” (당 대표 불출마 선언한 우원식 “與 분열·반목 보기 힘들어”)

Former National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik announced on the 21st that he would not run in the Democratic Party of Korea’s national convention to elect its next leadership. Amid escalating factional strife and competition for party power, he stated, “We must move forward not with wounds and division, but as a larger, united Democratic Party.” (우원식 전 국회의장이 21일 더불어민주당 차기 지도부 선출을 위한 전당대회에 출마하지 않겠다고 밝혔다. 당내 계파 갈등과 당권 경쟁이 격화하는 상황에서 “상처와 분열이 아닌, 더 크고 하나 된 민주당으로 나아가야 한다”고 했다.)

In a statement posted on Facebook titled “Lawmaker Woo Won-shik’s Position on the Democratic Party National Convention,” the former speaker said, “Who is the Democratic Party for, and what is the convention for?” adding, “I have no intention of running in this convention.” (우 전 의장은 이날 페이스북에 올린 ‘민주당 전당대회 관련 우원식 의원 입장문’에서 “누구를 위한 민주당인가, 무엇을 위한 전당대회인가”라며 “저는 이번 전당대회에 나갈 생각이 없다”고 밝혔다.)

Woo had been widely mentioned as a key contender for party leadership. However, with this decision to step back, observers note that the Democratic Party’s convention is likely to narrow to a three-way race centered on Representative Jeong Cheong-rae, Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, and former Representative Song Young-gil. Representative Jeong is reportedly set to step down from his post as party leader this weekend after careful deliberation, and formally announce his bid for re-election on the 24th. (우 전 의장은 그동안 유력 당권 주자 중 한 명으로 거론돼 왔다. 그러나 이번 불출마 선언으로 민주당 전당대회는 정청래 대표, 김민석 국무총리, 송영길 전 대표를 중심으로 한 3자 구도로 압축될 가능성이 커졌다는 관측이 나온다. 정 대표는 이번 주말 고심을 끝내고 오는 24일 당 대표직에서 물러난 뒤 연임 도전을 공식화할 것으로 알려졌다.)

Recent weeks have seen intensifying tensions within and outside the Democratic Party over the next party leadership. Opinions within the party were divided over the possibility of Representative Jeong seeking a second term, while potential candidates like Prime Minister Kim and former Representative Song drew attention. Differences over the convention rules and the party’s operational direction have surfaced among factions, including those aligned with Representative Jeong and those leaning toward the so-called “pro-Moon” camp. Some critics have pointed to a temperature gap between the party and the presidential office on certain issues. Woo’s decision not to run is interpreted as an attempt to curb the trend of party power competition escalating into factional confrontations and party-presidential office conflicts. (최근 민주당 안팎에서는 차기 당권을 둘러싼 신경전이 이어져 왔다. 정 대표의 연임 도전 가능성을 놓고 당내 찬반이 엇갈렸고, 김 총리와 송 전 대표 등 잠재 주자들의 행보도 주목받았다. 친명계와 친청계, 비당권파 사이에서는 전당대회 룰과 당 운영 기조를 둘러싼 이견이 표면화됐다. 일부 현안을 놓고는 당과 대통령실 간 온도 차가 드러났다는 평가도 나왔다. 우 전 의장의 불출마 선언은 당권 경쟁이 계파 대결과 당청 갈등으로 확산하는 흐름에 제동을 걸려는 메시지로 풀이된다.)

Woo said, “As someone who started with the People’s Party and has been a lifelong member of the Democratic Party, I ask and ask again: Is the Democratic Party of today the party of the middle class and common people that President Kim Dae-jung started? Is it the national party imbued with President Roh Moo-hyun’s dreams?” (우 전 의장은 “평민당부터 시작해서 평생 민주당원이었던 사람으로 묻고 또 묻는다”며 “김대중 대통령이 시작한 중산층과 서민의 정당, 지금의 민주당이 그 민주당인가. 노무현 대통령의 꿈이 담긴 전국정당, 지금의 민주당이 그 민주당인가”라고 했다.)

He continued, “No matter how much I think about it, this just isn’t right,” adding, “If we hold this convention inflicting wounds on each other, mocking opponents, nitpicking flaws, and fostering division, what will be left of our party afterwards?” (이어 “아무리 생각해도 이건 정말 아니다”라며 “이렇게 서로에게 상처를 내고, 상대를 조롱하고, 흠집을 잡고, 분열을 키우면서 전당대회를 치르고 나면, 그다음에 우리 당에는 무엇이 남는 것인가”라고 했다.)

He also criticized the language used in internal disputes. “Nicknames so harsh they’re hard to utter are being mobilized to attack internal opponents,” Woo said. “It’s embarrassing and shameful.” (그는 당내 공방의 언어도 문제 삼았다. 우 전 의장은 “차마 입에 담기 어려운 멸칭들이 내부의 상대를 공격하기 위해 동원되고 있다”며 “민망하고 부끄럽다”고 했다.)

“The Democratic Party’s core role is not visible. People’s livelihoods don’t rest even for a day, but the Democratic Party’s clock isn’t ticking,” he stated. (그러면서 “민주당 본연의 역할이 보이지 않는다. 민생은 하루도 쉬지 않는데, 민주당의 시계는 움직이질 않는다”고 밝혔다.)

Woo also referenced the results of the last local elections. “If we don’t properly heed the warning the people gave us in the last local elections, there’s no future,” he said. “I urge those planning to run in the convention to be as courageous and honest as possible in seeing our Democratic Party’s reality as it is.” (우 전 의장은 지난 지방선거 결과도 거론했다. 그는 “지난 지방선거에서 국민께 받은 경고, 그 뜻을 제대로 새기지 못하면 미래는 없다”며 “전당대회에 나서려는 분들은 최대한 용기 있고, 정직하게 우리 민주당이 직면한 현실을 있는 그대로 봐줄 것을 요청한다”고 했다.)

He added, “As someone who has walked alongside the ‘underdog’ in the field all my life as a member of the Democratic Party, this is a plea because I can no longer bear to watch the party’s division and conflict. We must first clarify who the Democratic Party is for and what this convention is for.” (이어 “평생을 민주당의 당인으로, 현장에서 을(乙)과 함께 걸어온 사람으로서 당의 분열과 반목을 차마 더는 지켜보기가 힘들어서 드리는 당부”라며 “민주당이 누구를 위한 정당인지, 이 전당대회가 무엇을 위한 전당대회인지부터 분명히 해야 한다”고 밝혔다.)

“Only then will the competition for party power be meaningful,” Woo said. “We must no longer widen the gap between the Democratic Party and the people. We must move forward not with wounds and division, but as a larger, united Democratic Party.” <<>> (우 전 의장은 “그래야 당권 경쟁도 의미가 있다”며 “더 이상 민주당과 국민의 거리를 넓혀서는 안 된다. 상처와 분열이 아닌, 더 크고 하나 된 민주당으로 나아가야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Concerning "Lee Hwa-young's Perjury, Likely Acquitted in Appeal... Special Counsel to be Pursued" (與 “이화영 위증, 항소심서 무죄날 것…특검 계속 추진”)
item.description:
Concerning "Lee Hwa-young's Perjury, Likely Acquitted in Appeal... Special Counsel to be Pursued" (與 “이화영 위증, 항소심서 무죄날 것…특검 계속 추진”)

The National Assembly's Special Committee on the Prostitution of the Democratic Party of Korea stated on the 21st regarding the first trial ruling for former Gyeonggi Province Deputy Governor for Peace, Lee Hwa-young, that "it should have rightfully been an acquittal." (더불어민주당 조작기소 국정조사 특별위원회는 이화영 전 경기도 평화부지사의 1심 판결에 대해 21일 “무죄를 선고했어야 마땅했다”라고 했다.)

The previous day, the Suwon District Court sentenced former Governor Lee to four months in prison on charges of violating the National Assembly Testimony and Appraisal Act (perjury) related to the 'salmon drinking party' allegations. The court determined that "the statements of those involved who were in the prosecutor's office were consistent or mutually corroborative, whereas the defendant's statements lacked consistency and credibility," confirming a guilty verdict. This marked the first judicial ruling two years and two months after the 'salmon drinking party' allegations were raised. (전날 수원지법은 ‘연어 술 파티’ 의혹을 제기한 이 전 지사의 국회증언감정법 위반(위증) 혐의에 대해 징역 4개월을 선고했다. 재판부는 “검사실에 있었던 관련자들의 진술이 일관되거나 상호 부합하는 반면 피고인의 진술은 일관성이 없어 신빙성이 부족하다”며 유죄를 확정했다. ‘연어 술파티’ 의혹이 제기된 지 2년 2개월 만에 나온 첫 사법 판단이다.)

In response, lawmakers Seo Young-kyo, Lee Geon-tae, and Lee Yong-woo, members of the Democratic Party's Special Committee on Prostitution of Indictment, held a press conference and stated, "Although the result is a guilty verdict, in substance it is an acquittal. If the court had not followed the majority verdict of the jury but had only reasonably considered it, it should have rightfully delivered an acquittal, and there is a high likelihood it would have. Therefore, there is a very high chance of an acquittal in the appellate trial." (이에 민주당 조작기소 특위 위원인 서영교·이건태·이용우 의원은 이날 회견을 열고 “비록 결과는 유죄이지만 실질은 무죄”라며 “재판부가 배심원의 다수결 평결에 따르지 않고 합리적으로 참고만 했다면 무죄를 선고해야 마땅했고, 무죄를 선고했을 가능성이 높았을 것이다. 그러므로 항소심에서는 무죄가 선고될 가능성이 매우 크다”고 했다.)

They also raised questions about the jurors. The lawmakers said, "It is questionable whether the jurors, who are not legal experts, correctly recognized the legal principle that the burden of proof lies with the prosecutor when issuing their verdict opinion." (배심원들에 대한 의문도 제기했다. 이들은 “법률전문가가 아닌 배심원들이 입증책임이 검사에게 있다는 법리를 정확하게 인식하고 평결 의견을 냈는지도 의문”이라고 했다.)

Additionally, they noted, "In particular, former Ssangbangwool director Park Sang-woong's statement that he 'purchased 4 bottles of soju and 3 bottles of water at a convenience store in front of the Suwon District Prosecutors' Office on May 17, 2023,' is very strong evidence proving that alcohol was provided. This strong evidence also means that the prosecutor failed to prove guilt beyond a reasonable doubt." (또 “특히 박상웅 전 쌍방울 이사가 2023년 5월 17일 수원지검 앞 편의점에서 ‘소주 4병과 생수 3병을 구입했다’라는 것은 술이 제공됐다는 사실을 입증할 매우 유력한 증거”라며 “이 유력한 증거는 검사가 합리적인 의심이 없는 정도로 유죄를 입증하지 못했다는 뜻이기도 하다”고 했다.)

Seo Young-kyo, the chair of the special committee and also the chair of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee, expressed the need to push for a special counsel. Lawmaker Seo stated, "There are things uncovered by the special committee for the parliamentary investigation, and it has been revealed how much the prosecution used former Deputy Governor Lee as a scapegoat to target Lee Jae-myung and eliminate political opponents through investigation and indictment. We must hold them accountable and punish them for that, so a special counsel is absolutely necessary." (특위 위원장이자 국회 법제사법위원장인 서영교 의원은 특검 추진이 필요하다는 입장을 내놨다. 서 의원은 “국정조사 특위에서 밝혀낸 것들이 있고, 검찰이 얼마나 이재명 죽이기와 정적 제거를 위해 이 전 부지사를 희생양 삼아 수사·기소를 했는지 다 드러났다”며 “그 부분에 대해선 책임을 묻고 처벌을 해나가야 하므로 특검은 반드시 간다”고 했다.)

Lawmaker Lee Geon-tae also said, "If 3 out of 7 jurors think it's an acquittal, then it clearly hasn't been proven beyond a reasonable doubt. The fact that this result came out itself shows that a special counsel investigation is needed." (이건태 의원도 “(배심원단) 7명 중 3명이 무죄라고 생각하면 이건 합리적 의심이 없을 정도로 증명이 분명히 안 된 것”이라며 “이런 결과가 나왔다는 것 자체가 특검 수사가 필요하다는 것”이라고 했다.)

Furthermore, regarding the acquittal of former Governor Lee on charges of violating the Political Funds Act and the dismissal of charges for abuse of authority, obstruction of rights, obstruction of public duties through deception, and violation of the Local Finance Act, the Democratic Party lawmakers stated, "This confirms the fact that the political prosecution fabricated the indictment." (또한 이 전 지사의 정치자금법 위반 혐의 무죄, 직권남용 권리행사방해·위계공무집행방해·지방재정법 위반 혐의에 대해서는 공소 기각된 것에 대해 민주당 의원들은 “정치검찰의 조작기소 사실이 확인된 것”이라고 했다.)

They also added, "This ruling acknowledging the abuse of prosecutorial authority is a serious incident that denies the very purpose of the prosecution's existence. The prosecution must apologize to the people." (또 “공소권 남용을 인정한 이번 판결은 검찰의 존재 의미를 부정하는 중대 사태”라며 “검찰은 국민 앞에 사과해야 한다”고도 말했다.)

item.title: Fatherland Innovation Party: "Han Chan-sik's Past Indictment of Moon Aide Shows Anti-Reform Record" (조국혁신당 “한찬식 민정수석 과거 文참모 기소...반개혁적 전력”)
item.description:
Fatherland Innovation Party: "Han Chan-sik's Past Indictment of Moon Aide Shows Anti-Reform Record" (조국혁신당 “한찬식 민정수석 과거 文참모 기소...반개혁적 전력”)

On the 21st, as President Lee Jae-myung replaced some senior presidential secretaries, the Fatherland Innovation Party expressed "deep concern" over the appointment of Han Chan-sik, a former prosecutor, as the new Senior Secretary for Civil Affairs. The new senior secretary had a history of conflict with the previous Moon Jae-in administration. While serving as the head of the Eastern District Prosecutors' Office, he investigated the "Ministry of Environment blacklist" case under the Moon administration. (이재명 대통령이 21일 수석비서관급 고위 참모진 일부를 교체한 가운데, 검찰 출신 한찬식 신임 민정수석 임명에 대해 조국혁신당이 잇따라 “매우 우려된다”는 입장을 밝혔다. 한 신임 수석은 과거 문재인 정부와 갈등이 있었던 인물이다. 동부지검장으로 재임하며 문재인 정부의 ‘환경부 블랙리스트’ 사건을 수사했었다.)

Senior Spokesperson Park Byeong-eon of the Fatherland Innovation Party issued a statement titled "New Senior Civil Affairs Secretary Han Chan-sik: Concerns Over Anti-Reform Record" following the personnel announcement at the presidential office. He stated, "With the second phase of prosecutorial reform discussions—concerning the supplementary investigation powers of prosecutors and the issue of mandatory transfer of all cases—looming in the second half of this year, the appointment of Secretary Han raises very significant concerns." (조국혁신당 박병언 선임대변인은 이날 청와대 인사 발표 이후 ‘한찬식 신임 민정수석, 반개혁적 전력 우려된다’는 제목의 성명을 내고 “올 하반기 당면한 검사 보완수사권 및 전건송치주의 문제에 대한 검찰개혁 2단계 논의를 앞두고 있는 상황에서 한 수석의 임명은 우려되는 바가 매우 크다”고 했다.)

Senior Spokesperson Park added, "During his tenure as head of the Seoul Eastern District Prosecutors' Office, Secretary Han indicted former Environment Minister Kim Eun-kyung, as well as former presidential secretaries Song In-bae and Shin Mi-sook." He noted, "Although this case resulted in a guilty verdict in court, there were criticisms from the time of the investigation, questioning whether the interpretation of personnel vetting as abuse of authority was too broad." (박 선임대변인은 “한 수석은 과거 서울동부지검장 재직 시절 김은경 전 환경부 장관과 송인배, 신미숙 전 청와대 비서관을 기소한 바 있다”며 “이 사건은 비록 법원에서 유죄판결을 받은 바 있으나, 수사 당시부터 인사검증을 직권남용행위로 너무 넓혀서 해석한 것 아니냐는 비판이 제기된 바 있다”고 했다.)

He further stated, "Under the oversight of former Seoul Eastern District Prosecutors' Office head Han Chan-sik, the person in charge of the specific investigative work was former Criminal Division 6 Chief Joo Jin-woo. After leading this investigation, former Prosecutor Joo left the prosecution, joined the Yoon Suk Yeol presidential campaign, and served as part of the president-elect's transition committee handling personnel vetting, thus contributing to the birth of the Yoon Suk Yeol government." He also said, "When former Deputy Justice Minister Kim Hak-ui, who was under investigation for sexual crimes, attempted to flee overseas during Secretary Han's tenure as head of the Eastern District Prosecutors' Office, the official in charge took an emergency travel ban and requested subsequent approval, but Secretary Han rejected this request." (이어 “한찬식 전 서울동부지검장의 총괄 아래, 구체적 수사실무를 담당한 사람이 주진우 전 형사6부장이었다”며 “주진우 전 검사는 이 수사를 주도한 이후 검찰을 떠나, 윤석열 대선후보 캠프를 거쳐 당선인 인수위원으로서 인사 검증을 담당하는 등, 윤석열정부 탄생에 일조한 바 있다”고 했다. 이어 “한 민정수석은 서울동부지검장 재직 당시 성범죄혐의로 수사선상에 있던 김학의 전 법무부 차관이 해외로 도피하려 하자, 담당자가 긴급히 출국금지조치를 취하고 사후 추인을 요청하였음에도 이를 거부한 전력도 있다”고도 했다.)

Senior Spokesperson Park urged, "The government and the Democratic Party must face the public's concerns over the revival of the mandatory transfer of all cases and the retention of prosecutors' investigative powers, and take the lead in achieving a complete separation of investigation and indictment." (박 선임대변인은 “정부와 민주당은 전건송치주의부활·검사의 수사권 존치에 대한 국민적 우려를 직시하고, 수사기소 완전분리를 위해 앞장서야 할 것”이라고 했다.)

Hwang Hyeon-seon, head of the Talent Recruitment Committee for the Fatherland Innovation Party, also posted on Facebook that day, saying, "I can't stand it..." and asked, "Did (Representative of the People Power Party) Joo Jin-woo recommend (Secretary Han)? What kind of person is this to be appointed as Senior Civil Affairs Secretary?" (황현선 조국혁신당 인재영입위원장도 이날 페이스북 글에서 “참을 수가 없어서...”라며 “(한 수석을) 주진우 (현 국민의힘 의원)가 추천했나? 뭐 이런 자를 민정수석으로”라고도 했다.)

The Democratic Party of Korea did not issue a separate statement regarding the presidential office's personnel changes that day. A Democratic Party official said, "The presidential office provided a sufficient explanation of the president's intent behind the appointments, so we decided not to release any additional messages." (더불어민주당은 이날 청와대의 인사에 대해 별도 입장을 내지는 않았다. 민주당 관계자는 “청와대가 이 대통령의 인사 취지에 대해 충분히 설명을 해 별도로 추가 메시지를 내지 않기로 했다”고 했다.)

item.title: New Senior Secretaries for Civil Affairs: Han Chan-sik, Public Relations: Seong Gi-hong, and Social Affairs: Kim Kyung-ja (신임 민정수석 한찬식, 홍보수석 성기홍, 사회수석 김경자)
item.description:
New Senior Secretaries for Civil Affairs: Han Chan-sik, Public Relations: Seong Gi-hong, and Social Affairs: Kim Kyung-ja (신임 민정수석 한찬식, 홍보수석 성기홍, 사회수석 김경자)

On the 21st, the presidential office announced a reshuffle of senior-level staff, replacing five senior secretaries, including the Senior Secretary for Civil Affairs, the Senior Secretary for Public Relations and Communication, the Senior Secretary for Social Affairs, and the First and Third Deputy Directors of the National Security Office. President Lee had previously signaled a reorganization of the presidential office after his first year in office. Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik stated on the same day, “This reshuffle focuses on swiftly realizing the vision for the second year of governance, an ‘Irreplaceable Republic of Korea,’ based on the achievements of the past year.” <<> Han Chan-sik, a lawyer at Kim & Chang Law Firm and a former prosecutor who served as chief of the Suwon District Prosecutors' Office and the Seoul Eastern District Prosecutors' Office, was appointed as the new Senior Secretary for Civil Affairs. President Lee appointed a former prosecutor to the post, following former Senior Secretary Bong Wook, to oversee prosecutorial reform. Both former Secretary Bong and new Secretary Han left the prosecution and were working at Kim & Chang Law Firm before being selected for the role. <<> Chief Kang said of Secretary Han, “He is a legal professional who has balanced the strictness of law enforcement with human rights sensitivity,” adding, “He will strengthen accountability in the public service in the second year of governance and flawlessly complete prosecutorial reforms, including the establishment of a Major Corruption Investigation Office and a Public Prosecution Office.” <<> Seong Gi-hong, former president and CEO of Yonhap News Agency, was appointed as the new Senior Secretary for Public Relations and Communication. New Secretary Seong, a former Yonhap News reporter, has served as political editor, editorial writer, head of the news department and president of Yonhap News TV, and president of Yonhap News Agency. <<> Chief Kang stated, “We expect him to carefully listen to the people's voices toward an ‘Irreplaceable Republic of Korea’ and provide thorough communication with the public and robust support so that the people can easily feel the government's achievements.” <<> Kim Kyung-ja, a visiting professor at the College of Liberal Arts at Woosuk University, was appointed as the new Senior Secretary for Social Affairs. New Senior Secretary Kim Kyung-ja has served as a member of the Ministry of Health and Welfare's National Pension Fund Management Committee, vice chairperson of the Korean Health and Medical Workers' Union, and senior vice chairperson of the Korean Confederation of Trade Unions (KCTU). <<> This appointment places a former senior vice chairperson of the KCTU in charge of labor, pensions, education, and welfare. Secretary Kim, a pharmacist, is a former laid-off worker from Inha Hospital and played a role in establishing the Seongnam City Medical Center, one of the long-cherished projects of President Lee Jae-myung during his tenure as mayor of Seongnam. Chief Kang said, “Secretary Kim is a health and medical expert with a background as a pharmacist and a labor activist, a leader who has driven change in our society.” <<> Two out of three deputy directors of the National Security Office were replaced. Kang Geon-jak, a member of the Presidential Committee for Future Defense Strategy and a former commander of the 6th Corps, was appointed as the First Deputy Director of the National Security Office. Chief Kang stated, “Deputy Director Kang, a former Army general, is a security expert who has consistently presented coherent problem awareness and realistic alternatives regarding the military's political neutrality, self-reliant defense capabilities, and military structure reform. He is an expert who will further strengthen national security capabilities.” <<> Song Ki-ho, the current Economic Security Secretary at the presidential office, was appointed as the Third Deputy Director of the National Security Office. Deputy Director Song, a former member of Lawyers for a Democratic Society (Minbyun), was appointed as Director of the National Crisis Management Center at the launch of the current administration before moving to the position of Economic Security Secretary under the Third Deputy Director. He was promoted to deputy director in this reshuffle. <<> Regarding the Third Deputy Director Song, it was stated, “Over the past year, he has played a pivotal role amidst a rapidly changing trade environment, including changes in U.S. tariff policy and supply chain risks stemming from the Middle East,” adding, “We expect him to maintain continuity and stability in economic security policies while actively and swiftly responding to new security threats.” <<> With the personnel announcement, five senior-level positions were replaced. When the vacant position of Senior Secretary for AI Future Planning is filled, a total of six senior secretaries will have been replaced. Chief Kang stated, “The replaced senior-level officials account for more than one-third and close to one-half of the total,” adding, “It is accurate to view this as a medium-to-large scale reorganization of the presidential office.” He continued, “It can be interpreted as reflecting a will not to be lax in pursuing further reform and self-discipline.” <<> (청와대는 21일 민정수석과 홍보소통수석, 사회수석, 국가안보실 1차장과 3차장 등 수석급 5명을 교체하는 참모진 개편 인사를 발표했다. 이 대통령은 취임 1년을 지나 청와대 개편을 예고해 왔다. 강훈식 비서실장은 이날 “이번 인사는 지난 1년의 성과를 토대로 국정 2년 차 비전인 ‘대체 불가 대한민국’을 속도감 있게 구현하는 데 중점을 뒀다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Dueling Remarks from Democratic Party Leaders… Chung "One Team for Party, Government, Presidential Office" – Kim "Toward a Winning Democratic Party" (全大 신경전… 정청래 “당정청 원팀” 김민석 “이기는 민주당으로”)
item.description:
Dueling Remarks from Democratic Party Leaders… Chung "One Team for Party, Government, Presidential Office" – Kim "Toward a Winning Democratic Party" (全大 신경전… 정청래 “당정청 원팀” 김민석 “이기는 민주당으로”)

Democratic Party leader Chung Cheong-rae and Prime Minister Kim Min-seok attended the June 3 local election winners' workshop side by side on the 21st. (더불어민주당 정청래 대표와 김민석 국무총리가 21일 6·3 지방선거 단체장 당선자 워크숍에 나란히 참석했다.)

Chung highlighted President Lee Jae-myung’s achievements, invoking the spirit of a unified party, government, and presidential office, while Kim stressed the need to build a "solid Democratic Party" that prevents the president from wavering. The two are likely to face off in the August 17 party convention for the next party leadership. <<> At the workshop held in the National Assembly Members’ Office Building conference room, Chung said, “Our goal is one, and everyone here shares it: the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration and the renewal of the regime,” adding, “Going forward, the party, government, and presidential office will unite as one team to complete the remaining livelihood and reform tasks.” <<> After outlining President Lee Jae-myung’s four major national goals, he stated, “It is an era-defining duty for the Democratic Party to join hands with the government and realize them,” emphasizing, “To align with the Lee Jae-myung administration and create an irreplaceable Republic of Korea, the role of everyone here is more crucial than ever.” <<> Prime Minister Kim also took the podium, saying, “Creating a Democratic Party that wins again is another challenge for us.” He added, “We have four years left – if the central government falters, if the president falters, what can we accomplish?” He stressed, “To firmly establish an unshakable Democratic Party, we must retie our shoelaces as a party that gives confidence in winning this time, winning next time, and winning in the future.” <<> He continued, “We must move forward with the president at the center, with the party and government perfectly unified, firmly holding the DNA of reform, and embracing a winning formula of livelihood, pragmatism, and expansion,” and emphasized, “When I return to the party soon, I will do my utmost, however modestly, to achieve that.” <<> The two also offered different interpretations of the June 3 local election results. Chung cited the Democratic Party’s first victory in the Gangwon Donghae City mayoral election, saying, “The brilliant performance gave us great inspiration,” but added, “At the same time, we will humbly accept the severe reprimands and criticism the public sent during the election process.” <<> Kim stated, “We achieved good results, but regrettably, there were outcomes that make it slightly difficult to declare a complete victory,” and concluded, “We all need to reflect more, innovate more, and push further forward.” (정 대표는 이재명 대통령 성과를 강조하며 당·정부·청와대 원팀 정신을 언급했고, 김 총리는 대통령이 흔들리지 않도록 하는 ‘단단한 민주당’을 세워야 한다고 했다. 두 사람은 8·17 전당대회에서 차기 당권을 둘러싸고 맞붙을 가능성이 높다.)

item.title: People Power Party Praises "Jang Dong-hyeok's All-Out Effort" in June 3 Local Elections... Oh Se-hoon Says "Had to Be Careful Avoiding Jang Who Appeared in Seoul" (국힘 “6·3 지선 장동혁 혼신” 자평...오세훈은 “서울 출몰하는 張 피하느라 신경”)
item.description:
People Power Party Praises "Jang Dong-hyeok's All-Out Effort" in June 3 Local Elections... Oh Se-hoon Says "Had to Be Careful Avoiding Jang Who Appeared in Seoul" (국힘 “6·3 지선 장동혁 혼신” 자평...오세훈은 “서울 출몰하는 張 피하느라 신경”)

On the 21st, the People Power Party issued a press release stating, "In the June 3 local elections, Party Leader Jang Dong-hyeok covered all 16 cities and provinces, giving his all for the victory of the candidates." This was interpreted as effectively evaluating the local election as a win and presenting a self-assessment that Leader Jang led the effort. The previous day, Seoul Mayor-elect Oh Se-hoon remarked, "I had to be careful during the election period to avoid (Party Leader Jang Dong-hyeok)." (국민의힘이 21일 “6·3 지방선거에서 장동혁 대표가 16개 시·도 전체를 아우르며 후보자들 당선을 위해 혼신을 다했다”는 내용의 보도자료를 냈다. 사실상 이번 지방선거를 승리로 평가하며 장 대표가 이를 이끌었다는 식의 자평을 내놓은 것으로 해석됐다. 전날 오세훈 서울시장 당선인은 “선거 기간 (장동혁 대표를) 피해 다니느라 신경 좀 썼다”고 말했다.)

The People Power Party released a press release titled "Analysis of the Results of the 9th Nationwide Simultaneous Local Elections and the June 3 National Assembly By-Elections" on the same day, stating, "Despite the reckless political oppression of the Lee Jae-myung regime and the severe confusion in election management by the National Election Commission, we did our best." (국민의힘은 이날 ‘제9회 전국동시지방선거 및 6·3 국회의원 재·보궐선거 결과 분석’ 보도자료를 내고 “이재명 정권의 무도한 정치 탄압과 선거관리위원회의 심각한 선거 관리 혼선에도 불구하고 최선을 다했다”고 밝혔다.)

The People Power Party particularly emphasized Leader Jang’s nationwide campaign rallies during the local election period. The party stated, "During the election period, Leader Jang attended a total of 18 events in 12 regions, including election committee inauguration ceremonies, 'certain victory' rallies at city and provincial party branches, and opening ceremonies of candidate election offices, urging the unity of all party members," and "During the official campaign period, he toured various regions, holding a total of 56 campaign rallies." (국민의힘은 특히 지방선거 기간 장 대표의 전국 지원 유세를 강조했다. 당은 “장 대표는 선거 기간 전 시·도당 선거대책위원회 발대식·필승결의대회와 후보자 선거사무소 개소식 등 총 12개 지역 18차례 행사에 참석해 전 당원의 결집을 독려했다”며 “공식 선거 운동 기간에는 지역 곳곳을 순회하며 총 56차례의 지원 유세를 펼쳤다”고 했다.)

The party claimed that Leader Jang’s campaign rallies "drew enthusiastic responses from young voters in their 20s and 30s, who were angered by the runaway Lee Jae-myung regime and the Democratic Party." (당은 이 같은 장 대표의 지원 유세가 “폭주하는 이재명 정권과 민주당에 분노하는 2030 청년 유권자들의 뜨거운 호응을 이끌어냈다”고 했다.)

Regarding the election results, the party effectively assessed them as a strong performance. The party stated, "In this election, we produced 4 elected regional heads, 95 elected basic local government heads, 328 elected regional councilors, and 1,277 elected basic councilors. In the concurrently held National Assembly by-elections, we also produced 4 elected candidates." It then compared the results to the 2018 local elections, held after the impeachment of former President Park Geun-hye. The party said, "Compared to the 7th local elections, the number of elected candidates increased by 2 regional heads, 42 basic local government heads, 191 regional councilors, and 268 basic councilors, respectively." (선거 결과에 대해서도 사실상 선전했다고 자평했다. 당은 “이번 선거에서 광역단체장 4명, 기초단체장 95명, 광역의원 328명, 기초의원 1277명의 당선인을 배출했으며 함께 치러진 국회의원 재·보궐선거에서도 4명의 당선인을 배출했다”고 했다. 그러면서 박근혜 전 대통령 탄핵 이후 치러진 2018년 지방선거와 비교했다. 당은 “7회 지선과 비교하면 당선인 수는 광역단체장 2명, 기초단체장 42명, 광역의원 191명, 기초의원 268명 각각 증가했다”고 했다.)

The party added, "Despite such difficult circumstances, we will focus the party’s capabilities so that all citizens can personally experience the achievements of the 9th popularly elected local governments, which you have helped build by joining forces," and "We will also resolutely confront the Lee Jae-myung regime’s future attempts to destroy the constitutional order and the judiciary, such as calls for 'trial cancellation.'" (그러면서 “이처럼 어려운 상황 속에서도 국민 여러분께서 힘을 모아 만들어주신 민선 9기 지방정부의 성과를 모든 국민이 몸소 체감하실 수 있도록 당의 역량을 집중하겠다”며 “‘재판 취소’ 등 앞으로 이어질 이재명 정권의 헌정 말살·사법 파괴 시도에도 단호하게 맞서 싸울 것”이라고 했다.)

Meanwhile, Seoul Mayor-elect Oh Se-hoon appeared on TV Chosun's "Tough Opponents" the previous day and commented on Leader Jang’s campaign rallies, saying, "There were difficult moments when I had to avoid him." He added, "In the last few days of the election, he came up to the Seoul metropolitan area and started appearing in Seoul," and "I thought clashing with him wouldn’t help the vote count, but with one or two days left in the election, his schedule started overlapping with mine. I had to be careful to avoid him." (한편 오세훈 서울시장 당선인은 전날 TV조선 ‘강적들’에 출연해 장 대표의 지원 유세에 대해 “피하느라고 어려운 순간도 있었다”고 했다. 그는 “선거 마지막 며칠 남겨놓고는 수도권으로 올라오시고 서울에 출몰하기 시작했다”며 “부딪히는 것은 득표에 도움이 안 된다고 생각했는데 (선거) 하루 이틀 남겨놓고는 제 동선과 겹치는 일정이 나오기 시작했다. 피해 다니느라 신경 좀 썼다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Song Young-gil: "Is Jung Cheong-rae Running to Fight President Lee?" (송영길 “정청래, 李 대통령과 싸우겠다고 출마하나”)
item.description:
Song Young-gil: "Is Jung Cheong-rae Running to Fight President Lee?" (송영길 “정청래, 李 대통령과 싸우겠다고 출마하나”)

Ahead of the Democratic Party of Korea's August 17 national convention, Rep. Song Young-gil, a potential candidate for the next party leadership, said on the 21st regarding the possibility of incumbent leader Jung Cheong-rae seeking a second term, "Is the head of the ruling party trying to confront the president right now?" (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회를 앞두고 차기 당권 주자로 거론되는 송영길 의원이 21일 정청래 대표의 연임 도전 가능성과 관련해 “집권당의 대표가 지금 대통령과 맞서자는 것인가”라고 말했다.)

Appearing on KBC Gwangju Broadcasting that day, Rep. Song stated, "I will watch whether Party Leader Jung Cheong-rae runs," adding, "If Rep. Jung enters the race, the likelihood of my candidacy increases significantly." (송 의원은 이날 KBC광주방송에 출연해 “정청래 당대표 출마 여부를 지켜보겠다”며 “정 대표가 나오면 제 출마 개연성이 훨씬 커지는 것”이라고 했다.)

Regarding his own decision to run in the convention, Song said, "I really want to see whether the public sentiment in Gwangju, South Jeolla, and especially North Jeolla Province gives Song Young-gil a mandate." He continued, "It will show up in opinion polls," and added, "The trend is gradually becoming visible, and I am currently ranking first among the three candidates in Gwangju." (송 의원은 자신의 전당대회 출마 여부에 대해 “정말 광주·전남, 특히 전라북도에서 호남의 민심이 송영길에게 소명을 부여하는지 여부를 좀 보고 싶다”고 했다. 이어 “여론조사를 해보면 나오는 것”이라며 “흐름이 조금씩 조금씩 보이기 시작해서 제가 광주에서 지금 세 후보 중 1등으로 나오고 있다”고 말했다.)

On the possibility of Rep. Jung's re-election, Song commented, "Everyone has the right to run," but questioned, "Is it truly desirable for Party Leader Jung Cheong-rae to run again under the current circumstances?" When the host asked, "Does that mean if Rep. Jung runs, Song Young-gil will also run?" Song replied, "The likelihood increases significantly." (정 대표의 연임 가능성에 대해서는 “모두가 출마의 권리가 있다”면서도 “과연 지금 같은 상황에서 정청래 당대표가 다시 출마하는 게 바람직할 것이냐”고 했다. 진행자가 “정 대표가 나오면 송영길도 나간다는 것이냐”고 묻자 송 의원은 “그럴 개연성이 훨씬 커지는 것”이라고 답했다.)

The Democratic Party will hold its national convention on August 17 to elect the next party leader and Supreme Council members. This leadership election comes one year after the launch of the Jung Cheong-rae leadership system last August. As the convention aims to form a new ruling party leadership in the second year of the Lee Jae-myung administration, the competition for party power is drawing attention as a turning point for future party-government relations and the power structure within the ruling bloc. (민주당은 오는 8월 17일 전당대회를 열고 차기 당대표와 최고위원을 선출한다. 지난해 8월 정청래 대표 체제가 출범한 뒤 1년 만에 치러지는 지도부 선거다. 이재명 정부 2년 차에 새 여당 지도부를 구성하는 전당대회라는 점에서, 당권 경쟁은 향후 당정 관계와 여권 내 세력 구도의 분기점으로도 주목받고 있다.)

Rep. Song also expressed concerns over Rep. Jung's recent remarks and actions. When the host noted that Jung's statements, such as "The people are eternal, and the government is temporary" and "Party operations are handled by party members," could be interpreted as a move to clash with President Lee Jae-myung, Song said, "I am worried," adding, "Our party members are also concerned." (송 의원은 정 대표의 최근 발언과 행보를 두고도 우려를 나타냈다. 정 대표가 “국민은 영원하고 정권은 짧다”, “당 운영은 당원이 한다”는 취지의 발언을 해 이재명 대통령과 각을 세우는 것처럼 해석될 수 있다는 진행자의 질문에 송 의원은 “걱정이 된다”며 “우리 당원들도 다 걱정하고 있다”고 했다.)

Song remarked, "No, is the head of the ruling party trying to oppose the president now?" He added, "We should support the president's state affairs, and of course, if opinions differ, we need to advise and coordinate, but fundamentally, the ruling party is a political group that works as one with the government to take responsibility for state affairs." He then said, "Things are going too far off track, and I am very concerned." (송 의원은 “아니, 집권당의 대표가 지금 대통령과 맞서자는 것인가”라며 “대통령의 국정을 뒷받침하고, 물론 의견이 다르면 조언하고 조율해야겠지만 기본적으로 집권 여당은 정부와 한 몸이 돼서 국정을 책임지는 정치 집단”이라고 말했다. 이어 “너무 지금 엇나가고 있어서 걱정이 많다”고 했다.)

Recently, within and outside the Democratic Party, the so-called 'Myung-Cheong conflict' controversy surrounding the relationship between Rep. Jung and President Lee has been cited as a variable in the convention. Amid criticism of the leadership's responsibility over the evaluation of local and by-election results, accountability for the nomination process, and party operation methods, whether Rep. Jung will seek re-election has emerged as a key factor in the party power landscape. (최근 민주당 안팎에서는 정 대표와 이 대통령의 관계를 둘러싼 이른바 ‘명청 갈등’ 논란이 전당대회 변수로 거론돼 왔다. 지방선거와 보궐선거 결과 평가, 공천 과정 책임론, 당 운영 방식 등을 놓고 지도부 책임론이 제기되는 가운데 정 대표의 연임 여부가 당권 구도의 핵심 변수로 떠오른 상황이다.)

Regarding the so-called '90-degree folded bow' Rep. Jung made during President Lee's return ceremony, Song said, "I wonder if such an exaggerated action was necessary." He added, "I think President Lee needs a posture that accepts the meaning of the first-year press conference and the evaluation of this local and by-election." (송 의원은 이재명 대통령 귀국 행사에서 정 대표가 보인 이른바 ‘90도 폴더 인사’에 대해서도 “그렇게 과장된 행동을 할 필요가 있었을까 하는 생각이 든다”고 했다. 그는 “대통령께서 1주년 기자회견, 또 이번 지방선거와 보궐선거에 대한 평가의 의미를 수용하는 자세가 필요하지 않을까 생각한다”고 말했다.)

Asked about the background of Rep. Jung's continued controversial remarks, Song replied, "It's about pursuing his own brand of politics." Song said, "That kind of self-focused politics should move in a direction that cooperates with the success of the Lee Jae-myung government, which our era demands," and "If one prioritizes the interests of their inner circle and faction over the whole, the party's energy will drain." (정 대표가 파장이 큰 발언을 이어가는 배경을 묻는 질문에는 “자기 정치를 하겠다는 것”이라고 했다. 송 의원은 “자기 정치라는 것도 지금 우리 시대가 요구하는 이재명 정부 성공과 같이 공조하면서 나가는 방향으로 가야 한다”며 “전체보다 자기 측근과 계파의 이익을 앞세우게 되면 당의 에너지가 다 떨어지는 것”이라고 말했다.)

He continued, "With over 160 excellent lawmakers, the party leader is using the playing field too narrowly," and "There are many regrettable assessments that he only does politics with a few close aides." He added, "Instead of fully mobilizing the capabilities of all lawmakers, assigning them tasks, and managing state affairs and people's livelihoods like a proper ruling party, the party is being operated in a closed manner with only a few close associates." (이어 “160명이 넘는 훌륭한 국회의원들을 가지고 당대표가 너무 운동장을 좁게 쓴다”며 “측근들 몇 명만 데리고 정치를 한다는 안타까운 평가가 많다”고 했다. 그는 “전체 국회의원들의 역량을 풀가동시켜 임무를 부여하고 국정과 민생을 챙기는 집권당다운 모습보다는 몇몇 측근들만 데리고 폐쇄적으로 당을 운영한다”고 말했다.)

The competition for party power is also intertwined with the so-called 'New Lee Jae-myung' trend and the issue of defining the relationship between existing pro-Lee and hardline supporters and the party-member-centered line led by Rep. Jung. When asked about the background of the perceived confrontation between the 'New Lee Jae-myung' faction and those lumped together as 'Moon Jae-in, Cho Kuk, Kim Eo-jun, Jung Cheong-rae, Yoo Si-min,' Song said, "Such phenomena occur when one pushes their own power or interests within the party." However, he also noted, "Labeling people like that is not the right attitude," and "There is great diversity; defining someone based on one thing is wrong." (당권 경쟁은 이른바 ‘뉴이재명’ 흐름과 기존 친명·강성 지지층, 정 대표를 중심으로 한 당원 중심 노선의 관계 설정 문제와도 맞물려 있다. 송 의원은 ‘문재인·조국·김어준·정청래·유시민’ 등을 묶어 부르는 표현과 ‘뉴이재명’ 세력이 대립 구도가 된 배경을 묻는 질문에 “당내 자기 권력이나 자기 이해관계를 앞세우면 그런 현상이 나타나는 것”이라고 했다. 다만 그는 “그렇게 낙인찍고 하는 것은 옳지 않은 태도”라며 “수많은 다양성이 있는데 뭐 하나 가지고 규정하는 것은 옳지 않다”고도 했다.)

Asked whether he thinks Rep. Jung will actually seek re-election, Song replied, "Looking at the atmosphere of Party Leader Jung Cheong-rae's ongoing remarks, doesn't it seem like he will run again?" Song said, "I don't think President Lee, myself, or many of our party members view the recent local and by-elections as a victory." (정 대표가 실제로 연임에 도전할 것으로 보느냐는 질문에는 “지금 정청래 당대표께서 쭉 말씀하시는 분위기를 보면 다시 출마할 것 같지 않습니까”라고 했다. 송 의원은 “대통령님의 생각이나 제 생각이나 많은 우리 당원들의 생각은 이번 지방선거와 보궐선거를 승리로 인식하지 않고 있지 않느냐”고 말했다.)

He stated, "Public opinion polls rather assess that the People Power Party performed well, and the election results show the absurd situation where our Democratic Party's approval rating lags behind the People Power Party." He added, "But Rep. Jung's perspective seems to be, 'We did well anyway,' 'We won,' and 'Looking at the formalities, didn't we win many metropolitan governments?'" He continued, "Because of this fundamental difference in perspective, there is a large gap between his perception and that of the President, many party members, and myself." (그는 “국민 여론조사도 오히려 국민의힘이 선전했다고 평가하고, 선거 결과 우리 민주당의 지지도가 국민의힘보다 더 뒤처지는 황당한 상황이 된 것”이라며 “그런데 정 대표는 ‘그래도 잘했다’, ‘이겼다’, ‘형식상으로 봤을 때 광역자치단체 많이 이긴 것 아니냐’는 시각”이라고 했다. 이어 “이런 시각의 근본적 차이가 있기 때문에 대통령과 많은 당원들, 또 저의 인식과 큰 괴리가 있다”고 말했다.)

Regarding speculation about his appointment to a ministerial post related to foreign affairs or security, Song drew a line, saying, "The national convention is what's important right now." Song added, "More important than a ministerial position is that if this party collapses, it leads to a lame-duck presidency for the President," and "The President has spoken so strongly, yet the Jung Cheong-rae leadership denies this and is running head-on to fight the President. If this is not resolved, what will become of the ruling party?" (외교·안보 관련 장관 하마평에 대해서는 “지금은 전당대회가 중요하다”고 선을 그었다. 송 의원은 “장관보다 제일 중요한 것은 이 당이 만약 무너지면 대통령 레임덕으로 가는 것”이라며 “대통령께서 이렇게까지 말씀했는데 정청래 지도부가 이것을 부정하고 정면으로 대통령과 싸우겠다고 출마를 하는데, 이것을 정리하지 못하면 집권당이 어떻게 되겠느냐”고 했다.)

He added, "It's a crisis situation where we could completely lose the momentum for state affairs, so I am contemplating whether we should focus on the convention rather than on ministerial positions right now." (그러면서 “완전히 국정 동력을 상실할 수 있는 위기 상황이기 때문에 지금 장관이 문제가 아니라 전당대회에 집중해야 되는 게 아닌가 이런 고민을 하고 있다”고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, former National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik declared he would not run in the national convention that day. On social media, former Speaker Woo posted, "For whom is the Democratic Party, and for what purpose is the convention?" and "If we hold the convention by hurting each other, mocking opponents, finding faults, and fueling division, what will be left of our party afterward?" He stated, "If we fail to properly heed the warning we received from the people in the last local elections, there is no future." (한편 우원식 전 국회의장은 이날 전당대회 불출마를 선언했다. 우 전 의장은 SNS에 “누구를 위한 민주당인가, 무엇을 위한 전당대회인가”라며 “서로에게 상처를 내고, 상대를 조롱하고, 흠집을 잡고, 분열을 키우면서 전당대회를 치르고 나면 그다음에 우리 당에는 무엇이 남는 것이냐”고 했다. 그는 “지난 지방선거에서 국민께 받은 경고, 그 뜻을 제대로 새기지 못하면 미래는 없다”고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Prime Minister Kim: "Korea-U.S. Alliance Evolves into 'Global Pivotal Alliance'" (金총리 “한미 동맹, ‘글로벌 중추 동맹’으로”)
item.description:
Prime Minister Kim: "Korea-U.S. Alliance Evolves into 'Global Pivotal Alliance'" (金총리 “한미 동맹, ‘글로벌 중추 동맹’으로”)

<<>> Prime Minister Kim Min-seok stated on the 21st that "the Korea-U.S. alliance is evolving beyond the peace and prosperity of the Korean Peninsula into a 'global pivotal alliance' that jointly addresses complex global crises," adding that "Korea has grown into an irreplaceable partner in enhancing U.S. competitiveness." Prime Minister Kim made these remarks while attending the Korea-U.S. Friendship and Peace Conference held at the Grand Hyatt Seoul in Yongsan-gu, Seoul. ()

Prime Minister Kim is scheduled to visit China for a three-day, two-night trip from the 22nd to the 24th to attend the Summer Davos Forum, where he will hold meetings with high-ranking Chinese officials. It is known that he will formally announce his candidacy for the leadership of the Democratic Party around the end of this month, following the completion of the appointment process for Prime Minister nominee Han Sung-sook. (김민석 국무총리는 21일 “한·미 동맹은 한반도의 평화·번영을 넘어 글로벌 복합위기를 함께 해결하는 ‘글로벌 중추동맹’으로 진화하고 있다”며 “한국은 미국의 경쟁력을 높이는 데에도 대체 불가능한 파트너로 성장했다”고 했다. 김 총리는 이날 서울 용산구 그랜드 하얏트 서울에서 열린 한미우호 평화 콘퍼런스에 참석해 이 같이 밝혔다.)

In his congratulatory speech on the same day, Prime Minister Kim said, "The friendship between Korea and the United States was most dramatically and firmly proven amidst the flames of the Korean War that struck the Korean Peninsula 70 years ago. The United States rushed in without hesitation to uphold the universal values of humanity—freedom and peace." He continued, "Thanks to the veterans who sacrificed their brightest youth and lives to defend the freedom of a country they had never known, a nation they had never visited, and people they had never met—their noble sacrifice, which feels miraculous even now—the Republic of Korea exists as it is today." (김 총리는 22~24일 하계 다보스포럼 참석차 22일부터 24일까지 2박 3일 일정으로 방중해 중국 고위급 인사들과 회담을 가질 예정이다. 이후 한성숙 총리 후보자의 임명 절차가 끝나는 이달 말쯤 민주당 당 대표 출마 선언을 공식화할 것으로 알려졌다.)

Prime Minister Kim added, "In that regard, the private diplomatic activities of the Korea-U.S. Memorial Association, which strives to honor the sublime spirit of the war heroes and pass on the friendship between the two countries to future generations, are truly precious, meaningful, and appreciated." He stated, "Such passion is the very pillar that sustains the Korea-U.S. alliance more healthily and strongly. I hope today's conference will serve as a valuable milestone that elevates the bond between Korea and the U.S. to a higher level and reaffirms the value of global solidarity that transcends generations." (김 국무총리는 이날 축사에서 “한국과 미국의 우정이 가장 극적으로 굳건하게 증명된 것은 70년 전 한반도에 들이닥쳤던 6.25 전쟁의 포화 속에서였다. 자유와 평화라는 인류 보편의 가치를 지키기 위해 미국은 망설임 없이 달려와 줬다”며 “이름도 알지 못하던 나라, 한 번도 가본 적 없는 국가, 만난 적 없는 이들의 자유를 지키기 위해 자신의 가장 빛나는 청춘과 목숨을 바쳤던 참전용사들, 지금 생각해도 기적적인 그들의 고귀한 희생이 있었기에 대한민국은 오늘 대한민국이 존재할 수 있었다”고 했다.)

Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon, who attended the event, said in his following congratulatory speech, "When the Republic of Korea stood at the crossroads of its existence 76 years ago, countless young people willingly risked their lives and rushed to this land for a country with an unfamiliar name and for the freedom of people they had never met." He added, "Thanks to their courage and sacrifice, the Republic of Korea was able to rise from the ruins of the war and develop into a democratic nation and economic powerhouse that the world pays attention to." (김 총리는 “그런 점에서 참전영웅들의 숭고한 정신을 기리고 양국의 우호를 미래 세대로 이어가고자 노력하시는 한미추모사업회의 민간 외교 활동은 참으로 소중하고 뜻깊고 감사한 일”이라며 “이러한 열정들이야말로, 한미동맹을 더욱 건강하고 단단하게 지탱해 주는 버팀목이다. 오늘의 컨퍼런스가 한·미 양국의 유대를 한 단계 더 높은 차원으로 도약시키고, 세대를 초월한 글로벌 연대의 가치를 확인하는 소중한 이정표가 되기를 기대한다”고 했다.)

Mayor Oh stated, "The poorest country that once received help from around the world has now grown into a nation that contributes to peace and prosperity as a responsible member of the international community. I believe this is the greatest legacy left by the veterans." He noted, "In that sense, the efforts of the Memorial Association to pass on the names and spirit of the veterans to future generations are a truly valuable mission. The Seoul Metropolitan Government deeply sympathizes with this cause and created the 'Garden of Gratitude' in Gwanghwamun Square last month." (이날 행사에 참석한 오세훈 서울시장은 이어진 축사에서 “76년 전 대한민국이 존립의 기로에 섰을 때 수많은 젊은이들이 이름도 낯선 나라를 위해, 한 번도 만나본 적 없는 사람들의 자유를 위해 기꺼이 목숨을 걸고 이 땅으로 달려왔다”며 “그들의 용기와 희생이 있었기에 대한민국은 전쟁의 폐허를 딛고 일어나 세계가 주목하는 민주주의 국가이자 경제 강국으로 발전할 수 있었다”고 했다.)

Pastor Paula White, known as the "faith mentor" and close confidant of former U.S. President Donald Trump, was scheduled to attend the event but was absent due to health reasons. In a video message, Pastor White expressed, "The great opportunities that Korea enjoys were made possible by the dedication of the veterans," and "We remember the heroes who sacrificed their noble lives." She added, "Their courage is forever etched in history," and "Protecting the precious values they defended through bloodshed is the way to honor the sublime spirit of the U.S. and Korean war veterans." (오 시장은 “전 세계의 도움을 받던 가장 가난한 나라가 이제는 국제사회의 책임 있는 일원으로서 평화와 번영에 기여하는 나라로 성장했다”며 “저는 이것이야말로 참전용사 여러분께서 남겨주신 가장 위대한 유산이라고 생각한다”고 했다. 그는 “그런 의미에서 참전용사들의 이름과 정신을 후세에 전하려는 추모사업회의 노력은 참으로 값진 사명이라 생각한다”며 “서울시 역시 이러한 뜻에 깊이 공감하며, 지난달 광화문광장에 ‘감사의 정원’을 조성했다”고 했다.)

Attendees of the event included Pastor Lee Young-hoon, Chairman of the Korea-U.S. Memorial Association; Park Sun-keun, President of the Korea-U.S. Friendship Association; Vice Chairman Cho Hyun-sang of HS Hyosung; Chairman Choi Yoon-beom of Korea Zinc; officials from the U.S. Forces Korea and the U.S. Embassy in Seoul; former Minister of Foreign Affairs Yoon Young-kwan; and Professor Yoo Hyun-joon of Hongik University's School of Architecture. (이날 행사에는 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령의 ‘신앙 멘토’이자 최측근인 폴라 화이트 목사도 참석할 예정이었으나 건강상의 이유로 불참했다. 화이트 목사는 축사 영상을 통해 “한국이 누리고 있는 거대한 기회는 (한·미 참전용사들의) 헌신이 있었기에 가능했다”며 “고귀한 목숨을 바치신 영웅들을 기억한다”고 했다. 이어 “그분들의 용기는 (역사를 통해) 영원히 새겨져 있다”며 “피 흘려 지켜낸 소중한 가치를 지키는 것이 (한·미 참전 용사들의) 숭고한 뜻을 기리는 방법”이라고 했다.)

President Park Sun-keun and others are promoting the construction of a "Korean War UN Forces Memorial Park" in Seoul and worldwide, including the United States. In the political sphere, lawmakers from the People Power Party, including Na Kyung-won, Kim Ki-hyun, Yoon Sang-hyun, Cho Bae-sook, and Kim Eun-hye, attended. (이날 행사엔 한미추모사업회 이사장 이영훈 목사와, 박선근 한미우호협회 회장과 함께 조현상 HS효성 부회장과 최윤범 고려아연 회장, 주한미군 및 주한미국대사관 관계자, 윤영관 전 외교부 장관, 유현준 홍익대학교 건축학부 교수등이 참석했다.)

<<>> (박선근 회장 등은 서울을 포함해 미국을 비롯한 전 세계에서 ‘한국전쟁 참전 유엔군 추모공원’ 건립을 추진하고 있다. 정계에서는 나경원·김기현·윤상현·조배숙·김은혜(국민의힘) 의원 등이 참석했다.)

item.title: Jung Jeom-sik: "Calls for Jang's Resumption Should Be Gathered After the Struggle for Voting Rights is Resolved" (정점식 “張 사퇴론, 참정권 투쟁 정리된 후 의견 수렴”)
item.description:
Jung Jeom-sik: "Calls for Jang's Resumption Should Be Gathered After the Struggle for Voting Rights is Resolved" (정점식 “張 사퇴론, 참정권 투쟁 정리된 후 의견 수렴”)

<<>> Jung Jeom-sik, floor leader of the People Power Party, commented on the calls for party leader Jang Dong-hyuk's resignation emerging within the party on the 21st, stating, "Given that Leader Jang emphasizes focusing on the struggle related to the infringement of people's voting rights, it seems difficult to resolve this in a short period of time." However, he added, "This situation itself must be concluded as quickly as possible." ()

Floor leader Jung appeared on MBN's 'Current Affairs Special: Jeong Un-gap's In-Depth Analysis' that afternoon and said, "I will incorporate the thoughts of all lawmakers to seek a solution to this issue (the calls for Jang's resignation)." He elaborated, "The party's situation has become very complicated after the local elections. There are arguments that the party leader should resign taking responsibility for the defeat in the local elections, and amid discussions about the so-called ballot shortage incident where citizens' voting rights were infringed, is it right to show the public a divided party over the issue of the leader's resignation at this point? It can be divided into two groups: one advocating for careful and deliberate review." <<> When the host asked whether the issue could be resolved within the year, mentioning rumors of a possible resignation by next February, Jung responded, "Can it really go until next February?" adding, "Don't many lawmakers and citizens think this situation itself should be concluded as soon as possible?" (국민의힘 정점식 원내대표가 21일 당내에서 제기되는 장동혁 대표 사퇴론에 대해 “장 대표가 국민의 참정권 침해 문제와 관련한 투쟁에 집중하자는 말씀을 하시는 것으로 볼 때 단시일 내 해결하기는 어렵지 않나 하는 생각이 든다”고 했다. 그러면서도 “이 상황 자체가 빠른 시일 내 종결은 돼야 한다”고 했다.)

Regarding the party's press release that day stating that "Leader Jang Dong-hyuk gave his all across all 16 cities and provinces to secure the election of candidates in the June 3 local elections," Jung said, "I was not briefed on that in advance." Earlier that morning, in a document titled 'Analysis of the Results of the 9th Nationwide Simultaneous Local Elections and the June 3 By-elections for National Assembly Seats,' the party claimed, "Compared to the 2018 local elections, the number of elected candidates increased by 2 for metropolitan heads, 42 for basic local government heads, 191 for metropolitan councilors, and 268 for basic local councilors." (정 원내대표는 이날 오후 MBN ‘시사스페셜 정운갑의 집중분석’에 출연해 “의원들의 생각을 다 담아내 이 부분(장 대표 사퇴론)에 대한 해결책을 모색하겠다”며 이같이 밝혔다. 그는 “지방선거 끝난 이후 당 상황이 굉장히 복잡하다”며 “지선 패배에 대한 책임을 지고 당대표가 사퇴해야 한다는 주장과 소위 투표용지 부족 사태로 인해 국민들이 참정권을 침해받았다고 말씀하는 와중에 이 시점에 대표 사퇴라는 문제로 당내 분열하는 모습을 국민께 보여드리는 게 맞느냐. 천천히 신중히 검토하자는 두 부류로 나눠볼 수 있다”고 했다.)

Regarding this, Jung commented, "I think it reflects the views of election staffers who didn't go through the party's internal deliberation process," adding, "I understand it as an analysis from the party office level that didn't fully reflect our lawmakers' opinions." (그러면서 ‘내년 2월 (장 대표 사퇴) 이야기도 나오는데 연내 정리될 수 있겠느냐’는 진행자의 질문에는 “내년 2월까지야 갈 수 있겠느냐”며 “이 상황 자체가 빠른 시일 내 종결돼야 한다는 생각을 많은 의원과 국민이 하는 것 아니겠느냐”고 했다.)

On independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, Jung stated, "Most people acknowledge him as a pillar of the conservative camp," but noted, "The issue of reinstating his party membership is something that requires comprehensive consideration of lawmakers' opinions, party members' views, and the appropriateness of timing." He continued, "The fact that this issue hasn't been raised in the general meeting of lawmakers proves that the timing and procedures are not yet mature," and added, "The reinstatement issue must not escalate into another conflict within the party. As floor leader, I will handle this matter well." (정 원내대표는 이날 당이 “6·3 지방선거에서 장동혁 대표가 16개 시·도 전체를 아우르며 후보자들 당선을 위해 혼신을 다했다”는 내용의 보도자료를 낸 데 대해서는 “사전에 보고받지 못했다”고 했다. 앞서 당은 이날 오전 ‘제9회 전국동시지방선거 및 6·3 국회의원 재·보궐선거 결과 분석’이라는 제목의 자료에서 “2018년 지방선거와 비교해 당선인 수는 광역단체장 2명, 기초단체장 42명, 광역의원 191명, 기초의원 268명 각각 증가했다”고 했다.)
